corrections.text: The article quotes the RouterLink advisory (GHSA-57xq-rjx2-v5xh) as "permanently pinning the UrlTree and its associated query parameter dictionary in the heap until the SSR response completed." The advisory's wording is "the computed signal permanently pinned the UrlTree and its associated query parameter dictionary in the heap until the SSR response completed."

The article says the September 23 advisory describes raising Node.js's --max-old-space-size as a temporary measure, in contrast to the empty-path outlet advisory. The September 23 advisory does not use that word; it says the change raises the concurrency threshold "though this does not fully eliminate the vulnerability under sustained traffic." The empty-path outlet advisory gives equivalent guidance ("though it does not eliminate the issue").
